answer: Warnock was driving through a canyon in Lewiston, Idaho, on Wednesday when he saw the tree, then looked up to see an SUV dangling over the edge of a cliff. Warnock dashed from his car and scrambled up a hill to the Yukon and its driver, 23-year-old Matthew Sitko, who appeared to be in shock. Warnock then reached in and pulled Sitko out to safety -- a moment recorded by Kough's camera. Thanks to Warnock, Sitko went to the hospital with just minor injuries.
